label: daily-label-matcher-anchoring-loki-defaults
description: Regexp label matchers matched against the whole value, as Loki does (profiles/stream-selector-regexp-anchoring, profiles/label-filter-regexp-anchoring). The proxy sends a whole-value literal as an exact filter, `.*` as VictoriaLogs' match-all, a `.*`-wrapped literal as a substring regexp and anything else anchored (^(?s:re)$ in a selector, Loki's simplified ^(?:re)$ in a label filter), where it sent the pattern unanchored before. A Grafana multi-value variable over two services (logs and count by app), the single-value form (exact filter), an alternation over many streams, and label filters after | json (a literal alternation, anchored; a prefix, which Loki compares by substring). Run with the control set.
